runs.name: t1b-look-col
runs.description: colonies preset look check: marker, reporter (the most varied regulator), harmonic reporter, 6 min

evals.js: const c = await moire.grn.typesNow(); moire.grn.look.reporter = c.reporter.best ?? 0; return JSON.stringify({best: c.reporter.best, sd: c.reporter.bestSd, lin: c.lineages.map(l => [l.id, l.n, l.types, l.differ.map(d => d.out + ' ' + d.ratio.toFixed(1)).join(',')])})
